# to-stage, but the A presses continue past 85 s.
#
# The 85 s cutoff in to-stage.txt assumes the stage is up by then. When the
# title reaches the pre-stage movie later, the run sits in it for the rest of
# the capture (docs/BOOT_LOG.md, 2026-10-30). This timeline keeps tapping A so
# one of the presses lands inside the movie and skips it. In gameplay an A is
# an attack, which is harmless for a static capture.
